text: ポケモン　おもいの　おんなのこ　ね

structure.jp: ポケモン　おもいの

patterns.name: 〜思い
patterns.span: ポケモン　おもいの
patterns.explanation: おもい added after a person or thing means 'caring a lot about' them. ポケモン　おもいの = 'who cares about Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜ね
patterns.explanation: ね right after a thing, with no だ, is a soft womanly way to say 'isn't it'. おんなのこ　ね = 'a girl, aren't you'.
